results.rationale: Provided capability records are project deployments and do not evidence agreement to a 120-day bid validity period (an administrative/legal tender condition).
No evidence demonstrates the proposal will be submitted in two separate sealed envelopes marked as required; listed caps are unrelated project experience.
No evidence shows ability/commitment to submit one original and two copies of each proposal (technical/financial); the cited caps do not address submission format.
Project experience does not evidence compliance with addressing proposals to the specified officer/department/location (an administrative delivery instruction).
No evidence indicates the bidder will structure the response to cover proposal sections Q1–Q7 as listed in the RFP; the caps are unrelated implementation records.
